For Petitioner(s): Mr.R.Rameshraja  For Respondent(s): Mr.D.Ravichander,
 Special Government Pleade  Mr.Stalin Abhimanyu,
 Additional Government Ple  M/s/S.R.Sumathy (For R3)
 ORDER
This Writ Petition has been filed to implement the Arbitration Award dated 20.12.2024 passed in the National Highways Act, 1956.

2.The only recourse available to the petitioner to implement the aforesaid award passed under the National Highways Act, 1956 is to file an Execution Petition as per the provisions of Section 36 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
Instead of filing the Execution Petition, the petitioner has filed this Writ Petition.

3.When this Court expressed its view that the petitioner will have to approach the Execution Court for executing the arbitration award dated 20.12.2024, the learned counsel for the petitioner, on instructions, would now submit that the petitioner may be granted liberty to approach the Executing Court.
_ Page2 of 4 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 09/03/2026 01:25:39 pm )

4.In view of the same, this Writ Petition is disposed of by granting liberty to the petitioner to execute the arbitration award dated 20.12.2024, in accordance with the provisions of Section 36 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, before the appropriate Executing Court.
There shall be no order as to costs.
